cases.description: When the underlying BarSeries contains no bars, getSize() should return 0.
When the BarSeries contains exactly one bar, getSize() should return 1.
When the BarSeries contains a typical positive number of bars (e.g., 42), getSize() should return that number.
When the BarSeries reports the maximum int value as its bar count, getSize() should correctly return Integer.MAX_VALUE without overflow.
When the BarSeries contains exactly two bars, getSize() should return 2.
When the BarSeries contains a large but non‑maximum positive number of bars (e.g., 999,999), getSize() should return that exact count.
When the BarSeries reports Integer.MAX_VALUE‑1 as its bar count, getSize() should correctly return 2147483646 without overflow.
If a custom/mock BarSeries incorrectly returns a negative bar count (e.g., -1), getSize() will propagate that value; this test verifies the method does not perform validation on the count.
After creating a BarSeries with 5 bars, adding one more bar should cause getSize() to reflect the updated count (6).
When the underlying BarSeries throws a RuntimeException from getBarCount(), getSize() should propagate the exception.
When the CashFlow instance is constructed with a null BarSeries, calling getSize() should throw NullPointerException.
